descricao: Base resource type for all video streams. Classes that derive from VideoStream can all be used as resource types to play back videos in VideoStreamPlayer.

metodos.desc: Called when the video starts playing, to initialize and return a subclass of VideoStreamPlayback.

propriedades.desc:
The video file path or URI that this VideoStream resource handles.
For VideoStreamTheora, this filename should be an Ogg Theora video file with the .ogv extension.
